# WA’s 2026 primary election tests Trump’s grip on both parties

By 

Anumita Kaur

 and 

Shauna Sowersby

Seattle Times staff reporters

Nearly a decade after Donald Trump upended American politics, Washington state’s primary election is offering a window into what comes next. [...] “Trump being in office is like a bat signal to Democrats to come out and vote,” he said. “We’ve seen that everywhere, and I expect you’ll see it again in August in Washington.”

How Democrats vote will offer a measure of the party’s appetite for a more confrontational left-wing agenda.
